best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm2 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the D/BarHI temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'Dm2' is FBbt:00003769 'distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm2'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052309 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Distal medullary wide-field amacrine neuron whose cell body is located in the cell body rind of the medulla. It terminates with a small bushy arbor with mixed terminal morphology in layers M3-M6B. The arbors in M6B extend into neighboring columns on the dorsal side. The small arbors cover 2 columns in M6 and one in the other layers. It is cholinergic (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.
